newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE CROWNED EUROPEAN CHAMPIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE CROWNED EUROPEAN CHAMPIONS.

text.p: Brive became the second successive French club to win rugby union's European Cup when they defeated English opponents Leicester 28-9 in the final at Cardiff Arms Park on Saturday.

Showing plenty of strength and speed behind the scrum, Brive scored four tries to nil, including two for winger Sebastien Carrat, and would have triumphed by a wider margin with more accurate goalkicking.
Leicester led 9-8 for a brief spell early in the second-half but ultimately did not possess the firepower to prevent Brive succeeding Toulouse as European champions.
The game was watched by a crowd of 40,664, almost double the number who attended the tournament's inaugural final on the same ground last season.
